g.text: What's up between you and Kaya?

g.text: How do you feel about Flare?

g.text: i mean she doesn't like me very much

g.title: j3824823165
g.text: im so glad they're heeere!! a real musician omllll

g.title: j4025866575
g.text: To be fair, I don't think she likes anybody very much.

g.text: she's going through a lot. like a lot a lot

g.title: j3135520351
g.text: especially after all they've been thru?! can u even imagine???

g.title: j1119721659
g.text: lol being a teenager sucks enuf as it is without piling on everything else u know?

g.title: j803645907
g.text: im not going 2 freak out about it or anything its her right

g.text: i didn't know who i was at that age. no CLUE. totally lost. all i did was try 2 be who i thought other ppl wanted me 2 be

g.text: i can... only kind of remember everything that happened to us

g.title: j2812068808
g.text: add on top everything that happened 2 her?

g.text: it's like a dream. sometimes i get nightmares about it, u know? but when i wake up, it's all gone, and everybody is still here

g.title: j633588907
g.text: AAAND the end of the world?

g.title: j2507613405
g.text: if she doesn't want 2 like me, that's totally fine lol

g.title: j3285055278
g.text: i lost a lot of friends in the ICR... like a lot a lot. but u go into fighting knowing thats going 2 happen

g.title: j1612372834
g.text: i'll be here 4 her if she ever wants a friend or if she ever needs me

g.title: j1379072918
g.text: flare's a musician. all they wanted 2 do was create art and make change in the world...

g.title: j2022293938
g.text: and if she doesn't? thats fine 2

g.text: it makes me wanna do very bad things to viktor when he has keys in his pocket

g.title: j3688747003
g.text: Huh. I really thought it'd bother you more that someone around here didn't like you.

g.title: j75435561
g.text: I just worry about her. I hope she's going to be okay.

g.title: j1931801066
g.text: Let me know when. I'll help.

g.title: j94070981
g.text: <3 sometimes u can only wait 4 people 2 be ready 4 u

g.title: j157079608
g.text: ^_^; i mean, im joking. <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE> unless im not hehe

g.text: sometimes if u try 2 force people into "friendships" or into being ready for something they're not ur gonna just cause problems

g.title: j3615459497
g.text: OH and the guitar is super weird, isn't she?! she's SUUUUPER sweet when you get past the...
